sn12.63:1.2: bhikkhave āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhavesinaṃ vā anuggahāya || || 3
sn12.63:1.4: Kabaliṃkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā || phasso dutiyo || manosāñcetanā tatiyā || viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ || ||
sn12.63:1.5: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhavesinaṃ va anuggahāya || || 4
sn12.63:2.1: Kathaṃ ca bhikkhave kabaliṃkāro āharo daṭṭhabbo || || 5
sn12.63:2.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave dve jayampatikā parittaṃ sambalam ādāya kantāramaggaṃ paṭipajjeyyuṃ ||
sn12.63:2.4: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave dvinnaṃ jayampatikānaṃ kantāragatānaṃ yā parittā sambalamattā sā parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya ||
sn12.63:2.6: Atha kho tesam bhikkhave dvinnam jayampatikānam evam assa || ||
sn12.63:2.7: Amhākaṃ kho yā parittā sambalamattā sā parikkhīṇā pariyādiṇṇā ||
sn12.63:2.9: Yannuna mayaṃ imam ekaputtakaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ vadhitvā vallūrañca soṇḍikañca karitvā puttamaṃsāni khādantā evantaṃ kantārāvasesaṃ nitthareyyāma || mā sabbeva tayo vinassimhāti || || 8
sn12.63:2.10: Atha kho te bhikkhave dve jayampatikā tam ekaputtakam piyaṃ manāpaṃ vadhitvā vallūrañca soṇḍikañca karitvā puttamaṃsāni khādantā evantaṃ kantārāvasesaṃ nitthareyyuṃ ||
sn12.63:2.11: te puttamaṃsāni ceva khādeyyuṃ ure ca patipiṃseyyum
sn12.63:3.2: api nu te davāya vā āhāram āhareyyum || madāya vā āhāram āhareyyuṃ || Maṇḍanāya vā āhāram āhareyyuṃ || vibhūsanāya vā āhāram āhareyyunti || ||
sn12.63:3.4: Nanu te bhikkhave yāvadeva kantārassa nittharaṇatthāya āhāram āhareyyunti || ||
sn12.63:3.6: Evam eva khvāhaṃ bhikkhave kabaliṃkāro āhāro daṭṭhabbo ti vadāmi ||
sn12.63:3.7: kabaliṃkāre bhikkhave āhāre pariññāte pañcakāmaguṇiko rāgo pariññāto hoti ||
sn12.63:3.8: Pañcakāmaguṇike rāge pariññāte natthi taṃ saññojanaṃ yena saññojanena saññutto ariyasāvako puna imam lokam āgaccheyya || || 12
sn12.63:4.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave gāvī niccammā kuḍḍañce nissāya tiṭṭheyya ye kuḍḍanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ ||
sn12.63:4.3: rukkhañce nissāya tiṭṭheyya ye rukkhanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ ||
sn12.63:4.4: udakañce nissāya tiṭṭheyya ye udakanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ ||
sn12.63:4.5: ākāsañce nissāya tiṭṭheyya ye ākāsanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ || ||
sn12.63:4.6: Yaññad eva hi sā bhikkhave gāvī niccammā nissāya nissāya tiṭṭheyya ye tannissitā tannissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ ||
sn12.63:4.7: Evam eva khvāhaṃ bhikkhave phassāhāro daṭṭhabbo ti vadāmi || || 14
sn12.63:4.8: Phasse bhikkhave āhāre pariññāte tisso vedanā pāriññātā honti ||
sn12.63:4.9: tīsu vedanāsu pariññātāsu ariyasāvakassa natthi kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti vadāmi || || 15
sn12.63:5.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā puṇṇā aṅgārānaṃ vitacchikānaṃ vītadhūmānaṃ ||
sn12.63:5.3: Atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikkūlo ||
sn12.63:5.4: tam enaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā tam aṅgārakāsum upakaḍḍheyyuṃ ||
sn12.63:5.5: atha kho bhikkhave tassa purisassa ārakāvassa cetanā ārakā patthanā ārakā paṇidhi || || 17
sn12.63:5.7: Evaṃ hi bhikkhave tassa purisassa hoti || ||
sn12.63:5.8: Imaṃ cāhaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ papatissāmi tato nidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti || ||
sn12.63:5.9: Evam eva khvāhaṃ bhikkhave manosañcetanāhāro daṭṭhabbo ti vadāmi || 18
sn12.63:5.10: Manosañcetanāya bhikkhave āhāre pariññāte tisso taṇhā pariññātā honti ||
sn12.63:5.11: tīsu taṇhāsu pariññātāsu ariyasāvakassa natthi uttariṃkaraṇīyanti vadāmi || || 19
sn12.63:6.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave coram āgucāriṃ gahetvā rañño dasseyyuṃ ||
sn12.63:6.3: Ayante deva coro āgucārī || imassa yaṃ icchitaṃ taṃ daṇḍam paṇehīti ||
sn12.63:6.5: Gacchatha bho imaṃ purisaṃ pubbaṇhasamayaṃ sattisatena hanathāti ||
sn12.63:6.7: Atha rājā majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ evaṃ vadeyya || ||
sn12.63:6.11: Gacchatha bho tam purisaṃ majjhantikasamayaṃ sattisatena hanathāti ||
sn12.63:6.17: Gacchatha bho tam purisaṃ sāyaṇhasamayaṃ sattisatena hanathāti ||
sn12.63:6.20: Api nu so puriso divasaṃ tīhi sattisatehi haññamāno tato nidānaṃ dukkham domanassam paṭisaṃvediyethāti || ||
sn12.63:6.21: Ekissa pi bhante sattiyā haññamāno tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha
sn12.63:6.22: ko pana vādo tīhi sattisatehi haññayamāno ti || || 24
sn12.63:6.23: Evam eva khvāhaṃ bhikkhave viññāṇāharo daṭṭhabbo ti vadāmi || || 25
sn12.63:6.24: Viññāṇe bhikkhave āhāre pariññāte nāmarūpam pariññātaṃ hoti || nāmarūpe pariññāte arivasāvakassa natthi kiñci uttariṃkaraṇīyanti vadāmīti || ||
